question: Is the s058 cloud-data forward-prop architecture cohort-viable without truth-cluster oracle injection, and if not, why does its score function fail to rank truth?
hypothesis: The cloud-data forward-prop architecture proven on seed 89 generalises blind across the cohort; the hit-count score ranks truth into a practical top-K.
narrative_md: Diagnostic thread (s059_pilot..s059h). Decisive negative on the architecture-as-was: the s058 'PROVEN-on-89' result relied on truth-cluster oracle injection; blind, the const-omega hit-count score ranks truth at 107/325 (seed 89) and 390/25k (seed 28). The score rewards const-omega trajectories that graze dense validator regions, not dynamics-consistent (q, omega) -- the candidate's finite-diff omega is ~17% off truth (so real dynamics ranks truth WORSE, 15502). s059e local-window LM polish reaches Band B (rho 0.31) but ONLY via truth-cluster injection. Principled reframe: omega-grid + real-dynamics + local-window surrogate-MSE (-> s059i/s059j). Reads truth ranks + oracle injection -- oracle-leak.
